gold.title: Calling s.search.TotalDocs() here may race with concurrent index creation: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without synchroniz
gold.description: Calling s.search.TotalDocs() here may race with concurrent index creation: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without synchronization, and the event watcher goroutine started just above could trigger BuildIndex writes concurrently, potentially causing a concurrent map read/write panic.

candidate.title: Unsynchronized read of the bleve index cache
candidate.description: TotalDocs() ranges over b.cache without taking cacheMu.RLock(), while BuildIndex writes under lock. Concurrent map read and write can cause fatal error, killing process. Also reachable from BleveIndexMetrics.Collect on every /metrics scrape. Fix: guard the reader with RLock/RUnlock.

missed_correctness_gold.title: A race condition in BuildIndex allows multiple goroutines to concurrently build the same expensive index for the same ke
missed_correctness_gold.description: A race condition in BuildIndex allows multiple goroutines to concurrently build the same expensive index for the same key. This is caused by moving the b.cacheMu lock from protecting the entire function to only protecting the final cache assignment.

promotion_candidates.title: Postgres skip papers over a startup-latency regression this PR introduces
promotion_candidates.description: NewResourceServer runs s.Init(ctx) synchronously, executing DB work before module reports running. Test has fixed 500ms sleep before checking /metrics, but on postgres in Drone this exceeds 500ms. Skip was disabled rather than fixed. Fix: replace fixed sleep with poll using require.Eventually.
